svg.text: One roll number. The complete student record.
Conceptual ERP diagram • No field tables or SQL • 11 October 2026
Unique within a school • Store as text • Keep leading zeros
Roll number identifies a student; it does not grant access.
ARROWS: 1 : N runs from one to many (zero or more). Repeated entity names refer to the same records.
School scopes every domain above. Staff use the same verified user and school-membership system.
Design assumption: the college-style roll number is permanent. Names remain stored, but roll number is the primary search.
Conceptual overview: detailed constraints, finance ledgers, timetable, events and approval rules are refined during schema design.
